title: Moving to a new city
instructions: Omar yeni bir şehre taşınmayı anlatıyor. Neden taşındığına ve ilk izlenimlerine dikkat et.

script.speaker: omar
script.text: Three weeks ago, I moved to Manchester for a new job.

script.speaker: omar
script.text: I didn't know anyone here, so the first week was quite lonely.

script.speaker: omar
script.text: But my colleagues are very friendly, and they invited me to play football on Wednesdays.

script.speaker: omar
script.text: The weather is rainier than in my home town, so I bought a good umbrella.

script.speaker: omar
script.text: Next month, my brother is coming to visit me.

questions.prompt: Why did Omar move to Manchester?
questions.evidence: I moved to Manchester for a new job.

questions.feedback: Kimseyi tanımadığı için ilk hafta oldukça yalnızdı.
questions.evidence: the first week was quite lonely.

questions.prompt: Who is coming to visit next month?
questions.evidence: Next month, my brother is coming to visit me.
